structured_output.reason: The census shows Phase 273's test-mode Stripe gateway, its signed webhook route and its checkout, invoice and terminal code already in place. This phase adds a poller that feeds the existing event handler (K65, option A), plus a limit check, a monitor and an upgrade guide, which adds to that code without changing what the existing routes do. It becomes a reshape if the build changes the webhook route or relaxes the live-key refusal in the gateway; in that case it goes to the operator.
structured_output.what_exists: The gateway in src/motodiag/payments/stripe_api.py pins stripe==16.0.0, which sends API version 2026-09-30.endive. Per Phase 273's handoff, it refuses a live key or live event unless the environment is prod, and it scrubs key-shaped text from its errors. The webhook intake is stripe_webhook in src/motodiag/api/routes/billing.py, which reads the Stripe-Signature header and verifies the raw body. Tests that sign payloads and post them through that route are in tests/test_phase273_invoice_payments.py. Phase 176's subscription path was repaired under F187 so that a tier change re-reads the subscription from Stripe. The CLI verbs from Phase 273 (shop payments connect and status, shop terminal setup and pay, shop invoice pay-link) are recorded in docs/ROADMAP.md. The Sentry DSN setting in telemetry/dsn.py, from Phase 343's log, is the existing place a monitor check-in would read its address from. Nothing yet in src shows a poller, a live-mode event source, a monitor check-in, a limit check or an upgrade guide.
structured_output.what_the_row_promises: Accept live payments: a shop reaches these through the Phase 273 CLI verbs, but only in test mode today; live use waits for the key, which is first used in the operator's step after the merge. Production webhooks: the row's endpoint model is superseded by K65's polling, and the existing route at billing.py is not reachable by Stripe while the backend is tailnet-only, so nothing yet reaches a production event. Subscription checkout and portal: reached through the existing billing routes (checkout-url and portal-url), test mode only. Alarm outside the desktop (K65 item 1): nothing reaches it yet. Daily limit notice (K65 item 2): nothing reaches it yet. Upgrade steps in the guide (K65 item 3): nothing yet. Live Connect onboarding with HTTPS return URLs: nothing yet; the public return page is undecided under K65.
structured_output.risks_and_stops: Operator-only, not yet granted: Stripe's live account and its key. K66 lets the fleet start before the account exists, but the live key is used only in the operator's step after the merge; stop there. Issue #54 keeps its hold (needs-admiral) until the operator takes it off, so the fleet does not start this phase's work before then. The public return page and customer share links while the backend is tailnet-only are undecided under K65; if the build needs either, that is a fork and goes to the operator. The shop-count and latency limits in K65 are the operator's to change; the builder uses them as given. A change to the webhook route or to the live-key refusal changes existing behaviour and is a reshape, so stop. The poll's place in the news is stored in the database, so it needs a migration; that is an addition, but the deploy skill's dry run, backup and approved diff apply. Open finding F248: config show prints stripe_webhook_secret in full, and live secrets will sit in the same configuration, so it should be fixed or planned before the live key is set. The row's title and text still say webhooks; the ledger should be updated as the work goes. None else found.
